captions.linkedin:
You can't control a cost you haven't measured.

Costs hide in three places: planning (rework from unclear plans and late changes), construction (delays and wasted materials) and operations (slow processes and duplicated effort).

The habit I'd build: spot, measure, fix, and track costs as work happens instead of after the fact.

Five leak checks: Where do we redo work? Where do we wait? Where do we waste materials? Where do we repeat effort? Where do we lack data?

#Operations #CostControl

Which leak is hardest to see in your business?
captions.x:
